plugins.name: swift-coding-standards
plugins.description: 所有 Swift 工程的默认编码规范与强制工具链（swift-format + SwiftLint）：命名、格式、注释、语言与并发约束、体量上限、17 类缺陷检测与完整整改流程。
plugins.description_en: Default coding standards and enforced toolchain (swift-format + SwiftLint) for every Swift project: naming, formatting, comments, language and concurrency constraints, size limits, a 17-category defect catalog, and a full remediation workflow.
